newsitem.title: UK: UK regulator reviews Go-Ahead rail deal.
newsitem.headline: UK regulator reviews Go-Ahead rail deal.

text.p: Britain's Office of Fair Trading said on Thursday it would consider whether the acquisition of a franchise contract to run Thames Trains by a group backed by bus company Go-Ahead Group Plc merited monopolies investigation.
In a statement the OFT said that it would invite representations about the implications for competition and other public interest aspects from any parties by November 28.
Go-Ahead has a 60 percent stake in Victory Railway Holdings, with the balance held by the former Thames Trains management.
Victory won the franchise on Septmber 19 and completed the agreement to run the train operating company on October 13.
The company was not initially available for comment.
Industry sources have previously pointed out that Go-Ahead runs a bus service between Oxford and London, parallel to some Thames Trains routes, though they do not see this as a competition issue.
